items.question: What is Remedium?
items.answer: Remedium is a trusted healthcare brand committed to delivering quality diagnostic, wellness, and aesthetic services through its specialized divisions and a customer-first approach.

items.question: What are the main divisions of Remedium?
items.answer: Remedium operates through three major healthcare divisions: Remedium Labs for diagnostics and pathology, Remedium Aesthetic for skin and aesthetic treatments, and Remedium Care for healthcare and patient-support services.

items.question: Who operates Remedium?
items.answer: Remedium is operated by Smilecure Lifestyle Private Limited through its healthcare divisions, service centres and franchise network.

items.question: Where are Remedium services available?
items.answer: Remedium services are available through participating centres and franchise locations. Service availability may vary depending on the city, branch and type of healthcare service required.

items.question: What services does Remedium Labs provide?
items.answer: Remedium Labs provides diagnostic and pathology services including blood tests, urine and stool tests, preventive health checkups, home sample collection and digital diagnostic report access.

items.question: Can I book a blood test through Remedium Labs?
items.answer: Yes. Patients can book available blood and pathology tests through participating Remedium Labs centres and supported digital booking channels.

items.question: Does Remedium Labs provide home sample collection?
items.answer: Yes. Home sample collection is available in eligible service areas. Trained phlebotomy personnel collect blood and selected diagnostic samples from the patient's location.

items.question: What types of diagnostic tests are available?
items.answer: Available tests may include CBC, blood sugar, thyroid profile, lipid profile, liver function, kidney function, urine testing, stool testing and other routine or specialized pathology investigations.

items.question: How can I receive my diagnostic report?
items.answer: Diagnostic reports may be provided digitally or through the respective Remedium Labs centre after laboratory processing. Availability and turnaround time depend on the test performed.

items.question: What services does Remedium Aesthetic offer?
items.answer: Remedium Aesthetic provides professional skin, hair and aesthetic services including laser hair reduction, skin rejuvenation, chemical peels, pigmentation care, acne and scar management and anti-ageing treatments.

items.question: Does Remedium Aesthetic provide laser hair reduction?
items.answer: Yes. Remedium Aesthetic offers laser hair reduction for suitable facial and body areas. Treatment plans are selected after consultation based on skin type, hair characteristics and individual requirements.

items.question: Do I need a consultation before an aesthetic treatment?
items.answer: Consultation is recommended before aesthetic procedures so that the appropriate treatment, suitability, expected outcome and required number of sessions can be assessed.

items.question: Does Remedium Aesthetic provide treatment for pigmentation and acne scars?
items.answer: Yes. Suitable pigmentation, acne and scar-management procedures are available. The recommended treatment depends on the condition, skin type and professional assessment.

items.question: What is Remedium Care?
items.answer: Remedium Care is the healthcare and patient-support division of the Remedium ecosystem, designed to provide accessible healthcare services and coordinated patient support.

items.question: What healthcare services are available through Remedium Care?
items.answer: Services may include primary healthcare support, physiotherapy, home healthcare, pharmacy assistance, preventive healthcare and patient-care coordination depending on location and availability.

items.question: Does Remedium Care provide physiotherapy services?
items.answer: Yes. Physiotherapy services may be available for rehabilitation, mobility support, pain management and functional recovery based on professional assessment.

items.question: Are home healthcare services available?
items.answer: Selected home healthcare and patient-support services are available in eligible locations. Availability depends on the type of care required and the service coverage of the local Remedium centre.

items.question: Does Remedium offer healthcare franchise opportunities?
items.answer: Yes. Remedium offers franchise and business partnership opportunities for entrepreneurs interested in developing diagnostic and healthcare service centres under the Remedium brand.

items.question: What franchise models are available with Remedium?
items.answer: Available franchise models may include FOCO, FOFO, Diagnostic Collection Centre and Master Franchise opportunities depending on territory, business eligibility and company expansion plans.

items.question: What is a Remedium FOCO franchise?
items.answer: FOCO stands for Franchise Owned Company Operated. The franchise partner owns or invests in the centre while Remedium provides structured operational support according to the applicable franchise agreement.

items.question: What is a Remedium FOFO franchise?
items.answer: FOFO stands for Franchise Owned Franchise Operated. The franchise partner owns and operates the centre while receiving approved branding, technology, operational and business support from Remedium.

items.question: Does Remedium provide franchise setup support?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on the franchise model, support may include site planning, branding, technology, operational workflow, recruitment, training, logistics and local business development assistance.

items.question: Can I apply for a Remedium franchise in my pincode?
items.answer: Yes. Applicants can enquire about franchise opportunities for their preferred pincode or territory. Availability depends on existing coverage, territorial eligibility and company approval.

items.question: How do I apply for a Remedium franchise?
items.answer: You can submit a franchise enquiry through the official Remedium website. The franchise team will review your preferred location, business profile and selected model before proceeding with verification and onboarding.

items.question: How can I contact Remedium?
items.answer: Customers and franchise applicants can contact Remedium through the official website, participating centres or authorized customer-support channels.

items.question: Can I find the nearest Remedium centre online?
items.answer: Yes. Customers can search for available Remedium Labs, Remedium Aesthetic and Remedium Care locations through the official website and supported location-search services.

items.question: Can I book Remedium services online?
items.answer: Online booking may be available for selected diagnostic, aesthetic and healthcare services. Available booking options depend on the service and participating Remedium location.

items.question: Are all Remedium services available at every centre?
items.answer: No. Services can vary by centre, location and division. Customers should check the respective centre page or contact the branch to confirm service availability before visiting.
